title: A Quantum-Inspired Two-Dimensional Lattice Polarized Radiative Transfer Simulator
summary: A quantum inspired framework was developed for polarized radiative transfer in the atmosphere to jointly model multiple scattering, absorption, and emission processes. The radiative field is represented by the Stokes vector and discretized using an n-directional two-dimensional spatial lattice on 3-dimensional uniformly distributed zenith and azimuth angular vectors. The formulation of this quantum computation system is based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method, which incorporates a physics-based polarized phase matrix.
